sermon.title: God Continues to Accept Good People, Satan Continues to Oppose Them 05/27/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Satan opposes even people who know God and the scriptures. God’s goal from the beginning is that we be good, and the Holy Ghost makes us good. Job was blameless, but with God’s permission Satan took his goods and children and used false friends against him. Job blamed God, then repented, prayed for his friends and was restored double.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Private names are in the transcript only. Garbled words are marked [unclear]. Kept as spoken: “Satan is not omnipotent” where the point is being in one place at a time (27:56); “1st Corinthians 11” for 1 Corinthians 10:11 (36:55); “the Bible says in Proverbs” for not following a crowd to do evil. Unverified: the church divorces at a higher rate than the secular world (26:53); the one-place view is “the 99% doctrine in America”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: condemns gloating when homosexuals died of AIDS (16:27); a minister’s profanity in a sermon and a church song with profanity (17:35–18:44). Divorce only for adultery or physical abuse (26:53). Joke about Job’s wife (32:40). Once accused God of killing seven innocent children (35:43). Judging examples: sex with a four-year-old; a police shooting (40:40).
